_doc: Words agents must not write. Read by hooks/word-guard.py; a repo adds its own in .claude/word-guard.json. action: deny refuses the write, warn lets it land and tells the agent to fix it. outward: also check commits, PRs, issues and GitHub writes.

entries.message: The user's name never goes in repo text, commits, PRs or issues. Write "the user".
The user dislikes rule, ruled and ruling. Say what was decided and who decided it: "decided", "the user's call", "chose".
